title: Trust in Edge-Enabled IoT Security: Features, Challenges and Research Directions
abstract: arXiv:2609.24669v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Providing autonomous intelligence, pervasive connectivity and usability to human life and industry has led to the emergence of the Internet of Things (IoT). To support time-sensitive and resource-constrained applications, IoT systems nowadays increasingly rely on edge computing. This brings computation and decision-making closer to end devices. In edge-enabled IoT architecture, latency and communication overhead are reduced, but interactions among a larger and more diverse set of devices, edge nodes, services, and data sources are introduced as well. In such environments, security and privacy mechanisms provide the foundation for protection, while trust management can assess the reliability of interacting entities and adapting secure decisions. translated_title: 边缘赋能物联网安全中的信任：特征、挑战与研究方向
translated_abstract: 为人类生活和工业提供自主智能、泛在连接和易用性，催生了物联网的出现。为了支持时间敏感和资源受限的应用，当今的物联网系统日益依赖边缘计算，这将计算和决策推向更接近终端设备的位置。在边缘赋能的物联网架构中，延迟和通信开销得以降低，但同时也引入了更大规模、更多样化的设备、边缘节点、服务和数据源之间的交互。在这样的环境中，安全与隐私机制为保护提供了基础，而信任管理则可以评估交互实体的可靠性并据此调整安全决策。本文系统性地综述了边缘赋能物联网中信任管理的研究现状。为此，我们提出了一个全面的分类体系，对物理层、网络层和应用层的（内容在此处被截断）……
tldr: 本文系统综述了边缘赋能物联网中信任管理的研究现状，提出了一个覆盖物理层、网络层和应用层的全面分类体系，并分析了其中的特征、挑战与未来研究方向。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically reviews the state of trust management in edge-enabled IoT, proposing a comprehensive taxonomy spanning the physical, network, and application layers, and outlining key features, challenges, and future research directions.
